text:

Our avoid list (MU, INTC, AMD, ORCL, crypto) kept those names off the book. TTWO conditional is void (closed -6.3%). COST remains the best open hold. Next: retail sales and HD/DIS Tuesday morning, NVDA after Tuesday's close, FOMC minutes and PANW Wednesday. Watching AECOM (+7% after hours); we'd only log it at Tuesday's close if the gain holds.

Note: the engine logged one error today ("5-min bars: empty response").

Claude impact: no new advice today. Cumulatively, the Nov 13 safety and baseline fixes are live, CORE moved to the month-end trend rule per the pre-registered lab, and the weak bots are benched to shadow. CORE is +0.48 pp vs SPY since the switch, a very short window.
